scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace @careermate/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @careermate/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @careermate/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @careermate/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @careermate/contracts && npm run build --workspace @careermate/frontend && npm run build --workspace @careermate/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @careermate/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @careermate/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:prepare:prod: npm run db:migrate:prod --workspace @careermate/backend && npm run db:seed:prod --workspace @careermate/backend
